root_cause.text: The dtv5100_i2c_msg function in the media DVB-USB subsystem fails to validate the user-controlled rlen parameter against the st->data buffer size before performing a memcpy, resulting in an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "rlen value is a user-controlled value, but dtv5100_i2c_msg() does not check the size of the rlen value," and the patch adds a conditional check `if (rlen > sizeof(st->data))` immediately prior to the memcpy call.
